messages.text:
"I would Like you to create a Game for mobile. This Game ist a 3d model/Charakter Editor. In this Game there ist a Body Editor for the 3d model. This Body Editor is able to Change everything in the Body of The 3d model. (Change eye colour, size of The model, give it a Sixpack, make Arms, legs, ... bigger/thinner, bigger/smaller ass, breasts, head,...). And there ist a clothes Editor in the Game. The clothes are changeable. (From blue Jeans and a Red sweater, to a pink Bikini, or a pink Bikini top and a orange Sports Shorts). And finally a Pose Editor.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
